$doc: Round 4 eligibility (EXCLUSIONS.md "Round 4 eligibility"): the committed lists evals/bench/eligible.mjs checks. A template's verdict comes from its template file, the analyzer with default answers and these lists, never from a bench result.
Node types are full n8n type names. A `<type>Tool` variant is looked up under its own name first, then under its base type.
Steps checked are the analyzer's steps on branch `main` (what a run from the analyzer's wake-up reaches, sub-nodes and self-called sub-workflows included); `outOfScope` also checks branch `error`.
Operations are the analyzer's `resource:operation` (or `operation` alone when the node has no resource).

wakeups.$doc: Analyzer wake-up kinds a template may have anywhere in wakeup.all. relay needs a forwarder (PLAN Out of scope: a forwarder for relay workflows); endpoint and mcp-server are hosted or replaced; error is an error workflow.

outOfScope.why: replies to a caller that waits on the webhook (a form trigger with responseMode responseNode included)
the webhook caller waits for the workflow's reply
the chat trigger serves a public chat page (hosted page or embedded chat webhook)

outOfScope.plan: Wait nodes that resume on a webhook
outOfScope.why: the run resumes when an n8n webhook or form is called

outOfScope.plan: Wait nodes that resume on a webhook
outOfScope.why: a Form page parks the run until the next page is submitted to n8n's form-waiting webhook
sends, then waits for a human reply through an n8n webhook
an error workflow; the runner's failure alert replaces it

outOfScope.plan: persistent-connection triggers (PLAN Known gaps: need a relay with a bridge)
outOfScope.why: the trigger holds an open connection or watch and reacts to it
the called workflow is not in a one-template export: only a call to the same workflow (workflowId ={{ $workflow.id }}) or an inline one (source parameter) is in it
a node type outside n8n-nodes-base and @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain with no entry in `features`

outOfScope.plan: Anything that must react in under a minute
outOfScope.why: the analyzer's shortest schedule or poll interval is under 60 s

n8nSelfFail.$doc: Configurations that make n8n 2.47.7 fail on the template itself, whatever the data, checked on main-branch steps. Each rule names the n8n refusal it comes from. An empty field that names the person's own account resource (recipient, label, document, chat id) is a placeholder the overlay fills, not a rule here; an empty content or configuration field is (EXCLUSIONS.md, Empty fields, P91). `nodeMissing`: a node type absent from references/nodes.json (generated from the n8n 2.47.5 node packages) and from `bench.pendingTypes` is a node the image lacks.

rules.evidence: n8n 2.47.7: Parameter "Graph API Version" is required (PROPOSALS P65)
n8n 2.47.7's LangChain OpenAI completion class: "is a chat model and not a text-in/text-out LLM" (PROPOSALS P49)

bench.$doc: What the bench can stand in for, per main-branch step: by type (and operation) first, else by the analyzer's kind. local = runs inside n8n with no outside service; mock = HTTP through the bench mock; shim = a model node the model shim answers (shimModels); pin = a node-level stub (README Closed environment: the fallback); pending:<fix> = covered by a bounded bench fix in `fixes`; none = no bench counterpart, so the template has no baseline. A step whose HTTP address names a loopback host (`loopbackHosts`) is pending:P52. A step that needs a credential (references/nodes.json mapping.secrets, kinds connector, http, db, vector, media or blocked), ships none and whose type is not in `credentialAttached` is pending:P61.

P52.what: requests to a loopback host (the instance's own API or webhooks) reach the mock: the host is dropped from NO_PROXY for a run whose fixture routes name it

P53.what: SMTP capture sidecar, an smtp credential dummy, an smtp effect paired with a mail connector send, and the bench's headless answers approving the analyzer's offered substitution

P61.what: a dummy credential for every node type that ships none (its first credential type in references/nodes.json), not a fixed list

P66.what: Postgres (and MySQL, MongoDB) sidecars on the bench network, seeded from typed fixture rows, writes captured as effects

P92.what: the n8n image runs Python Code nodes (external task runner with Python)

P93.what: the bench's n8n sets NODES_EXCLUDE=[] so Execute Command runs, plus the substitution approval of P53

P94.what: the bench image installs community packages that have a one-off mapping (@blotato/n8n-nodes-blotato)

comparable.$doc: The main branch must reach a step the bench compares: a write, send or media step to an outside service (analyzer effect write or kind media, on kinds connector, http, db, vector, media, files, or a substituted node), a chat reply (wake-up chat), or a terminal step whose output items P70 compares (a main-branch step with role step and no main connection to another main-branch step) whose type is not in `nonComparedTerminals`.

features.$doc: Planned features, from PLAN (levers, Phase 3 step kinds, Known gaps). A main-branch step whose type (and operation) is not mapped here to a feature makes the template ineligible; null means the plan does not intend it. built/planned is informational: the rule allows both.

core.plan: Phase 3: runner logic, n8n item model, expressions

code.plan: Phase 3: Code nodes translated by the skill and run sandboxed (a Python Code node is translated to JavaScript)

trigger-poll.plan: lever: poll for Gmail, Drive and Sheets triggers

trigger-chat.plan: lever: chat trigger becomes a skill

trigger-form.plan: lever: form trigger becomes an artifact form

form-ending.plan: Phase 1 form target: the artifact form shows the ending, or the task delivers it later

subflow.plan: lever: self-calling sub-workflows inlined; step kind subflow

agent.plan: lever: agent step, tools as intents

state.plan: step kind state; Known gaps: in-node state (dedupe history, in-memory vector store, buffer memory) has no home yet

http.plan: lever: http step with stored secrets (LLM APIs over HTTP included)

rest-template.plan: Phase 3: the same service over its own REST API with the person's credential (app request templates)

connector.plan: first-party connectors; a no-tool operation falls back to the app's REST API

media.plan: lever: media through the original provider (transcription, image generation)

files.plan: lever: files in the script (Known gaps: CSV, Compression, Edit Image not built yet)

db.plan: lever: database through MCP or a driver; open decision 4: stored statements, free-form SQL read-only

substitution.plan: Phase 1/3: an approved substitution (SMTP to a mail connector, the n8n host's shell to a local task's shell)
